skipRules.title: When notifications are not sent
skipRules.hint: The full list of cases where the system deliberately sends nothing.
skipRules.rule1: A booking from the journal has no client phone at creation time — no message
skipRules.rule2: "No-show" set after the visit already started — no cancellation to the client
skipRules.rule3: Confirmation request — only for a booking in "Awaiting client" status
skipRules.rule4: Review request — skipped if "Arrived" was set later than the allowed window
skipRules.rule5: Follow-up visit invite — skipped if the previous booking was not "Arrived"
skipRules.rule6: No-show invite — skipped if the client already has a future booking
skipRules.rule7: A cancelled discount is never sent to the client
skipRules.rule8: Cancelling a journal-created (non-online) booking is not sent to the client
skipRules.rule9: Changing the client on a booking, moving it to another card, deleting the card — no notifications
skipRules.rule10: Joining the waitlist does not by itself create a notification
skipRules.rule11: The client has no available channel (no push, SMS not connected) — not even attempted in the log
skipRules.rule12: A push to staff in "Do not disturb" mode does not arrive
skipRules.rule13: "Schedule ending soon" fires only when the schedule ends for ALL staff at the location
skipRules.rule14: The client turned this type or channel off in their card — no message
skipRules.rule15: The client opted out of marketing mailings — excluded from every mass mailing

checklist.title: Turning on team notifications
checklist.hint: Go through these four steps — otherwise the staff member gets nothing.
checklist.step1: Turn on channels ("Admin app" or Email) in "Sending channels"
checklist.step2: Turn on the admin and staff types in "Notification types"
checklist.step3: Give the staff member location access and a role ("Team" section)
checklist.step4: Set up who gets what in the staff member’s “Notifications” tab
checklist.noLocationWarning: Some staff have no location access — they get nothing, even with a role.
